newsitem.title: USA: VTX Electronics names Goodstein chairman.
newsitem.headline: VTX Electronics names Goodstein chairman.

text.p: VTX Electronics Corp on Thursday said it named Ed Goodstein chairman and chief executive.
VTX said in a statement its former chairman and chief executive, Albert Roth, agreed to step down in favor of Goodstein.
Roth also stepped down as president. That position goes to Howard Griffith, who previously was vice president for vendor relations for TW Communications, also of Farmingdale.
Goodstein is and will remain president and owner of TW Communications, in addition to his new duties at VTX.
VTX distributes electronic components and makes custom-made cable assembly products.
